notes.title: The release date is pushed further
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43689416/6631a9066e7a182386ccab8af5dd853d4a8db4e4.jpg[/img]

We have made good progress making the game, but due to other works we have had the release is pushed further a few months.

The gameplay of the second to last level is going to be finished this year, but the last level will be completed at earliest on February. Also out musics and sound effects still need a lot of work.

But rest assured, this game will be ready in few months. And we will NOT be using the players for game testing.

Sorry for the delay, we were a bit too optimistic.

notes.title: Objectives and Tips for Exit Doors coming
notes.notes:
[h1]Exit Doors has a redesigned Objective and Tips system[/h1]

We desided to redesign the whole objective and tips system. And here are the results. The idea is to have objectives and enable all of them with two tips. Player can have a new tip after waiting for some time. In Options you can choose if they come all, in 15 seconds, in 30 seconds or in a minute.

This feature will be in the next demo version very soon.

notes.title: Launch postponed to the end of the year
notes.notes:
Launch postponed to the end of the year

We have changed our plans so that we will not be doing DCL's, but are going to create one game that contains everything we had thought of. So little bit more waiting, but more content coming up!

Stay tuned!
